title.zh: 航空导航（受保护区——陆军总部与部队设施）命令 2024
title.en: Air Navigation (Protected Areas — Army Headquarters and Formation Facilities) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Air Navigation (Protected Areas — Army Headquarters and Formation Facilities) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 29 April 2024.

heading.en: Areas declared to be protected areas

text.en: 2. Any area described in the Schedule is declared to be a protected area for the purposes of sections 32 and 33 of the Act.
3. Revoke the Air Navigation (Protected Areas) (No. 2) Order 2015 (G.N. No. S 435/2015).
